subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Maui Pulls Islands
description: A quick win: understand Maui Pulls Islands.

hook.text: In Polynesian myth, Maui fished up islands from the ocean floor. He used a magical fishhook and tricked the sea.

buildup.text: Maui was born premature and thrown into the sea. The ocean rejected him. He came back stronger.

discovery.text: He also slowed the sun by beating it with a jawbone. Maui forced nature to serve human needs.

twist.text: Maui died trying to win immortality by crawling into a goddess's body. Even the greatest trickster has limits.

climax.text: Maui is the trickster as culture hero. He didn't create the world—he improved it, by force and cunning.

punchline.text: He fished up islands and lassoed the sun.

quiz.question: How did Maui die in Polynesian myth?
